title: Anthropic creates three access tiers for advanced cyber work
friendlyTitle: Anthropic offers stronger cyber tools to verified security teams
summary: Anthropic has expanded its Cyber Verification Program into Defense, Red Team and Specialized access tiers, with reduced cyber blocks for verified professionals according to their work and controls. Its evaluation found that the Defense tier blocked 46 of 50 offensive trials at some stage, while Red Team access completed 34 of 50 without classifier blocks.
friendlySummary: Approved security professionals can apply for one of three access levels. More sensitive work needs stronger checks and tighter controls.
whyItMatters: The program offers defenders a route to stronger capabilities without making them generally available, but access brings verification, monitoring and data-retention requirements. Security teams should choose the least-permissive tier that supports their authorized work and keep normal approval and audit controls around model actions.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Defenders may get useful help without giving every user the same powerful tools. Teams should use only the access they need and keep people responsible for every test.
